labels.inspect_stats: Recovered from {plans_recovered} setbacks, helped others {helped_others} times, placed {blocks_placed} blocks, prayed {prayers} times.
labels.inspect_faith_unaware: Has never heard of the god.
labels.inspect_stories: Has heard {count} stories of the god
labels.offer_already: That design has already been offered.
labels.offer_done: The design is offered. Those who listen now know it.
labels.stores_none_near: There is no storage chest here yet. Place one where people live.
labels.chest_owner: The people of {place} take from and store in this chest.
labels.chest_no_owner: No settlement stands here: nobody will use this chest.
labels.chest_hint: What you place here is theirs to use. Your own divine stock never is.
labels.interact_nothing: There is nothing here to use.
labels.interact_not_your_shrine: You are not manifested at this shrine.
labels.bed_hint: Lie down and let days pass. The world goes on without you.
labels.settlement_food: Food: {days} days for everyone ({meals} meals, {grain} grain, {berries} berries)
labels.settlement_winter_fear: Autumn, and too little put by for winter: they fear the cold months.
labels.settlement_top: A village stands on its own. From its shrine, its people can be asked to found a new settlement.
labels.standing_line_food_days: Days of food in the chests: {have} of {need}
labels.miracle_no_shrine: The shrine here is not active.
labels.miracle_renown: Too few know the god's name for that.
labels.miracle_favour: Not enough Favour at this shrine.
labels.miracle_kindled: A warmth settles over the place.
labels.miracle_veiled: Fog gathers and hides the place.
labels.miracle_sprouted: Berry bushes spring up from the grass.
labels.miracle_nothing_to_bless: There is nothing here to bless.
labels.whisper_nobody: There is no one to whisper to.
labels.whisper_unheard: Only the devout can hear a dormant god.
labels.shrine_menu_whisper_hint: To whisper, look at someone (Inspect) and choose Whisper.
labels.god_event_expelled: Cast out, the god finds itself at {shrine}
labels.request_posted: The request is spoken to the faithful.
labels.requests_hint: A request goes to this shrine's believers. Each decides for themselves; success costs {boon} Favour as a blessing.
labels.request_need_village: When {place} is a village, its people could found a new settlement on land they know.
labels.request_not_village: Only a village can spare people to found a new settlement.
labels.rest_title: The god rests at the shrine for {days} days…
labels.rest_quiet: The valley went about its days; nothing the chronicle would keep.
labels.save_autosaved: The world is saved for the new day.
labels.save_load_failed: The saved world could not be loaded: {error}
labels.save_version: the save is from another version
labels.pause_title: Save and leave to the title
labels.hud_controls: LMB break · RMB place · I blocks · E use · F inspect person · B designs · K settlement · J chronicle · Tab overlook
labels.hotbar_empty: This slot is empty. Press I to choose blocks for your hotbar.
labels.hotbar_slot_empty: Empty slot · press I to choose blocks
labels.inventory_hint: Choose a hotbar slot below, then a block to put in it. Right-click a slot to empty it. Placing a block uses one of its material from your divine stock.
labels.guide_gather: First: break blocks with the left button to gather materials (logs give wood, tall grass thatch).
labels.guide_hotbar: Press I and put a storage chest in your hotbar: your hotbar holds only the blocks you choose.
labels.guide_chest: Your people have nowhere to keep what they gather. Place the storage chest near the tree with the right button.
labels.guide_fill_chest: Look at the chest and press E to open it, then give it wood and berries. What lies in a chest is theirs to use; your own stock never is.
labels.guide_build: Build a small home near the tree: walls, a door, a bed under a roof. Place with the right button; 1-9 choose a block.
labels.guide_capture: Keep it as a design: press B, choose Capture in world, mark two corners around your home, then Save design.
labels.guide_offer: Offer the design at the tree (B, then Offer at the shrine). People who know you can now build it.
labels.guide_miracle: The travellers know you but do not yet believe. At the tree press E and work miracles near them (Bless Growth, Kindle). Each one seen deepens belief; answering their prayers deepens it most.
labels.guide_miracle_progress: Belief grows: {name} is at {devotion} of {needed}. Work more miracles near the travellers; answering a prayer counts most.
labels.guide_miracle_favour: Your Favour ({favour}) is too low for a miracle. Prayers at the tree restore it; Kindle costs the least.
labels.guide_request: Your believers can carry your name: at the tree press E, Requests, Carry my name to the Ridge Hamlet.
labels.guide_transfer: The Ridge Altar is awake. At the tree press E and step through to it.
labels.guide_rest: Let days pass: at the tree press E and Rest, then read what happened.
labels.guide_standing: {place} is a {standing} ({met} of {total} toward a {next}). {advice} Press K to see what it has.
labels.guide_lack_residents: More people will come to a place with spare beds, food in its chests and no threats nearby.
labels.guide_lack_housed: Some sleep without a home. Offer a home design, or bring wood and thatch to the chests.
labels.guide_lack_food_days: Its chests hold little food. A garden of planters feeds it and bears in winter; a field of farmland grows grain that keeps.
labels.guide_lack_dwelling: It needs more homes. Offer a home design; people build what they know.
labels.guide_lack_storehouse: It needs a storehouse: two storage chests and a door under a roof. Build one and offer it.
labels.guide_lack_hall: It needs a hall: a table and two benches under a roof, with room to gather. Build one and offer it.
labels.guide_lack_garden: It needs a garden: four or more planters side by side. Build one and offer it.
labels.guide_lack_shrine: Its shrine must be alive: believers who pray there keep it so.
labels.guide_found: {place} is a village. At its shrine press E, Requests, and ask its people to found a new settlement on land they know.
labels.guide_found_shrine: {place} has been founded. Ask its people to raise a shrine there, so you can step through to them.
labels.guide_dormant: The god sleeps. People who still believe may pray a shrine awake again.
